    db Dataset

    db.Rd

    This dataset contains the following variables:

    operator

    table for operators

    project

    table for projects

    provider

    table for (data) providers

    action

    table for action (e.g data download, data privider)

    p

    table for geographic/geospatial locations (e.g. stations/gauges locations), a sf object

    variable

    table for variaples (e.g. weather variales: precipitation/rainfall,temparature,...)

    ts

    table with time serirs (long table format)

    attribute

    table for attributes

    data(db)

    Format

    Data frames and vectors

    Source

    GSOD (through GSODR package)

    This dataset is intended for research purposes only, being distributed in the hope that it will be useful, but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY.

    Details

    This dataset stores all information about meteorological stations and instrumental timeseries. The user can easily use the package with their own data after replacing the values of such variables.

    Examples

    
## see below


   library(nomnoml)
   data(db)
   str(db)

   schema <- lapply(db, FUN=function(t, nfks) {
    print(nfks)
    o <- sapply(as.list(t), FUN=function(x) {class(x)})
    o2 <- data.frame(column=names(o), type=as.character(o))
      o2$reference <- as.character(NA)
      iin <- which(o2$column %in% nfks)
      o2$reference[iin] <- o2$column[iin]
      o2$reference[iin] <- stringr::str_sub(o2$reference[iin], end=-4)
      return(o2)
    }, nfks=sprintf("%s_id", names(db)))
#> [1] "operator_id"  "project_id"   "provider_id"  "action_id"    "p_id"        
#> [6] "variable_id"  "ts_id"        "attribute_id"

#> [6] "variable_id"  "ts_id"        "attribute_id"

#> [1] "operator_id"  "project_id"   "provider_id"  "action_id"    "p_id"        
#> [6] "variable_id"  "ts_id"        "attribute_id"
#> [1] "operator_id"  "project_id"   "provider_id"  "action_id"    "p_id"        
#> [6] "variable_id"  "ts_id"        "attribute_id"

    out2 <- list()
    for (it in names(schema)) {
      print(it)
      content <- paste(schema[[it]]$column, schema[[it]]$type, sep = ": ", collapse = "||")
      out2[[it]] <- sprintf("[<table>%s| %s]", it, content)
      inn <- which(!is.na(schema[[it]]$reference))
      if (length(inn) > 0) { 
      refs <- sprintf("[%s] <- 1..n[%s]", schema[[it]]$reference[inn], it)
      out2[[it]] <- c(out2[[it]], refs)
    }
 }
